newsitem.title: USA: Compaq expected to lower some PC prices- WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Compaq expected to lower some PC prices- WSJ.

text.p: Compaq Computer Corp is expected to reduce its corporate personal computer prices Wednesday in an attempt to halt progress made by Dell Computer Corp, The Wall Street Journal said.
In Wednesday's electronic edition, the paper said Compaq also plans to outline new production and distribution techniques aimed at allowing it to lower the prices without destroying profitability.
The newspaper said analysts called the move an attempt at pressuring Dell, which has been gaining market share among business buyers with its low prices, direct sales and quick turnaround.
The newspaper says unnamed Compaq executives told analysts and distributors that they intend the price cuts to be permanent.
